name: Ford - Parts Distribution Center, Rancho Cucamonga CA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Modern (built 2000) ~449k sq ft cross-dock warehouse. Office driveway has a visible sliding gate (2025 Street View); the two truck yards (north and south faces) are fenced/walled with controlled driveway entrances.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth visible at the driveway entrances in Street View; entrances are gated but unmanned-appearing. Flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Controlled gates, no booth - set true at low confidence.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Long continuous dock-door banks on BOTH the north and south building faces with many trailers backed in; ~70 estimated -> 50+ band.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailer parking in both the south yard and the shared north yard; ~55 trailers visible -> 25-50 / borderline 50+ band, called 25-50 conservatively.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-parking lots on both the south and north sides of the building.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: True cross-dock building - dock banks on physically separate north and south faces.
fieldNotes.entryExitSeparate: Separate truck yards / driveways serve the north and south dock faces.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur; dense Inland Empire warehouse district served entirely by truck.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Dense Rancho Cucamonga industrial/logistics district off a major arterial (Milliken Ave) -> Urban.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide truck yards and multiple driveway aprons leave room for an express lane.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~449k sq ft building on a ~28-acre parcel (overhead estimate from the perimeter box).
